# Revive Research

> Revive Research is a premium peptide research compound supplier focused on scientific transparency, third-party lab verification, and researcher education. All compounds are sold for research use only (RUO) and are not intended for human consumption.

## Most Important Sections

- [Peptide Catalog](/peptides): Full index of research peptides with purity specs and COA links.
- [Shop](/shop): Purchase individual research compounds.
- [Research Stacks](/research-stacks): Pre-built and custom peptide bundles with synergy analysis.
- [Certificate of Analysis Verification](/coa/verify-certificate-of-analysis): Verify third-party COA authenticity by batch number.
- [Batch Testing Archive](/coa/batch-testing-archive): Historical COA records for all released batches.
- [Peptide Education Center](/guides/peptide-education-center): Comprehensive research library covering mechanisms, safety, and handling.
- [Reconstitution Wizard](/reconstitution-wizard): Step-by-step guided calculator for peptide reconstitution math.
- [Peptide Reconstitution Calculator](/tools/peptide-reconstitution-calculator): Quick math tool for BAC water and dosing volumes.
- [Peptide Research FAQ](/peptide-research-faq): Answers to common researcher questions.
- [Peptide Academy](/academy): Gamified learning platform covering peptide science fundamentals.
- [Galaxy Explorer](/galaxy): Interactive 3D visualization of peptides organized by body system and synergy.
- [Research Resources](/peptide-research-resources): Curated external links to peer-reviewed literature.
